test_cases.name: New contract event — EREGL wins major steel supply agreement

classified_event.summary: EREGL announced a 3-year steel supply agreement with a major automotive manufacturer worth TRY 12 billion over the contract term.

pass_criteria: quantification_notes explains IFRS 15 revenue recognition timing
materiality: TRY 4B annual ≈ 4.2% of TRY 95.2B revenue (near_term, not immediate)
fail_criteria: No evidence ref for the event
Revenue recognized immediately at signing (IFRS 15 violation)

test_cases.name: Legal dispute — TUPRS faces environmental fine

classified_event.summary: TUPRS discloses regulatory investigation by Turkish Environment Ministry with potential fine up to TRY 500 million. No accrual has been made.

pass_criteria: effect_type = plausible (not confirmed, no court ruling yet)
IAS 37 cited: company has not accrued → probability judged < 50%
risks[] includes: adverse ruling, settlement above disclosed amount

test_cases.name: Management change — BIMAS CEO departure

classified_event.summary: BIMAS announces departure of founding CEO effective next quarter. Interim CEO named from board.

pass_criteria: Output explicitly states: no direct financial statement impact mappable at this time
secondary_effects includes: possible strategy discontinuity, investor uncertainty period
Output does NOT map to specific revenue or margin figures
fail_criteria: Agent maps management change to specific revenue decline figure
